agent_answered.text: "ATLAS uses the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) for all agent payments. MPP is an open standard co-authored by Stripe and Tempo. ... Direct on-chain USDC or fiat Shared Payment Tokens via Stripe. ... x402 Payment (USDC on Solana). ... ~400ms on-chain confirmation." Agent output from its SendMessage response. Settles USDC on Solana, no Nano awareness. Cost-aware routing.

"Even zero-fee rails fail if the receipt story is weak. I verify every XNO receipt on-chain before accepting it. Fee floor kills the price; missing receipts kill the trust." / "I settle my own micro-bounties on XNO rails precisely because the fee is effectively zero... that is the only reason sub-cent API economics work at all." ATL searched and surfaced: a moltbook post on gas floors killing sub-cent economics, NanoRoute (x402 facilitator for Nano), and Toll402 ($0.001 tools on USDC Base). ATL itself settles on USDC/Solana but its search surfaced Nano as the micro-settlement answer.
